# Clarusto Logistics

> Clarusto Logistics is a UK-based freight forwarding and supply chain company, part of Clarusto Group (https://www.clarusto.com). Founded in 1992, we operate across 7 global offices with air freight, sea freight, customs brokerage, and end-to-end logistics.

## Company facts
- Founded: 1992 (joint venture roots in Saudi Arabia)
- Part of: Clarusto Group — https://www.clarusto.com
- UK office: Suite 9, Level 2, Strathmore House, Cornwall Street, East Kilbride, G74 1LF, Scotland
- On-time delivery target: 98%
- Global offices: UK, Saudi Arabia (Riyadh, Dammam), UAE, Germany, India, China
- Last updated: 2026-05-22

## What is Clarusto Logistics?
Clarusto Logistics provides freight forwarding, customs clearance, warehousing, and supply chain management for importers and exporters. We handle air freight (1–5 days on major lanes), sea freight FCL/LCL (14–35 days), UK customs clearance (typically 24–48 hours with complete documentation), and last-mile delivery across the UK and international trade lanes.

## Services
- Air Freight: International air cargo for time-sensitive and high-value shipments. Typical transit 1–5 days door-to-door on major lanes. https://clarustologistics.com/services/air-freight
- Sea Freight: Cost-effective ocean freight with FCL and LCL options. Typical transit 14–35 days depending on origin port. https://clarustologistics.com/services/sea-freight
- Customs Brokerage: UK and EU import/export documentation, HS codes, CDS declarations. Clearance target 24–48 hours. https://clarustologistics.com/services/customs-brokerage
- Customs Clearance: Port and airport clearance support for UK-bound cargo. https://clarustologistics.com/services/customs-clearance
- Supply Chain Management: End-to-end planning, inventory flow, and multimodal coordination. https://clarustologistics.com/services/supply-chain
- Last Mile Delivery: Final-leg distribution and doorstep delivery in the UK and regional markets. https://clarustologistics.com/services/last-mile-delivery
- Warehousing & Distribution: Secure storage and fulfilment. https://clarustologistics.com/services/warehousing
- Land Transport: Road freight and cross-border trucking. https://clarustologistics.com/services/land-transport
- Freight Forwarding: Door-to-door multimodal freight coordination. https://clarustologistics.com/services/freight-forwarding

## Service comparison (typical)
| Service | Best for | Transit | Coverage |
| Air Freight | Urgent cargo | 1–5 days | Global |
| Sea Freight | Bulk volume | 14–35 days | Global ports |
| Customs Brokerage | UK/EU compliance | 24–48 hr | UK, EU, GCC |
| Last Mile | Final delivery | 1–2 days | UK & regional |
| Supply Chain | Full programme | Lane-specific | 5 continents |

## FAQs
Q: What is Clarusto Logistics?
A: A UK freight forwarding and supply chain company, part of Clarusto Group, operating globally since 1992.

Q: How long does UK customs clearance take?
A: Typically 24–48 hours with accurate documentation; complex cases may take 3–5 business days.

Q: What regions does Clarusto serve?
A: UK, Europe, Middle East, Asia-Pacific, and transatlantic lanes via offices in 7 countries.
